entries.html:
阅读与验证边界

题目条件、推导、变体与自测方法须结合使用。代码尚未在此运行验证，“通过”“实际落盘”“可运行”等描述不能代替独立测试；复杂度与版本说明只在注明前提下成立，不等于实测性能。

本学习路线不包含纯前端虚拟 DOM Diff；目录用于主题定位，具体学习内容以对应正文为准。

算法与数据结构面试手册

算法与数据结构

章节导航

  • 一、题设条件、数据结构与排序 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcnvlYSN4vJAJpfBYfDPvr1qh)
  • 二、数组、二分、双指针与区间 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcnZVPg1Io3G09QcgSYApXjym)
  • 三、字符串、窗口、前缀与单调结构 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcnrIJWeCuVAof4YDSZcFo1ld)
  • 四、链表、栈、队列与缓存 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcnihJrNBDWNt3Cu8safYWiYg)
  • 五、树、搜索树与跳表 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcnU2f4kWon1FVKjSzPfP8Fxg)

  • 七、回溯与贪心 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcnZSLf0ZP2tgNyGrcxhMgbrb)
  • 八、动态规划与状态设计 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcnmOlhOYE94x5YMbqphjZf4g)
  • 九、堆、随机与数值计算 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcn0s0gyj3cuCIJ8Xgg5w42Ye)

  • 十一、解析、对象路径与前端算法 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcnTLd6qlaGgVZ4KOWZsMXBCh)
  • 十二、检索、排序融合与结构化知识库 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/PU07w5G8zi0MqjkjGEecc33Mnxd#doxcnldS0nlYohytvBHsv5kG4gd)

先把输入条件和始终要保持的关系讲清，再选择数据结构，最后用边界和反例检验代码。面试中的好答案不只是报出“用双指针”：还要解释为什么可以移动这一端、丢弃这个状态，以及什么时候这套证明会失效。

如何使用这本手册

每道题先读第一段，把核心答案用自己的话说出来；再复述条件、推导、复杂度，最后闭卷写代码。练习时按“空输入、最小输入、重复值、极值、答案在首尾、无解、是否修改输入”检查。遇到恢复路径、相同答案如何选、并发或磁盘容量等追问，把它当作新增要求，重新确认原证明是否仍成立。

建议先练二分、双指针、前缀和、窗口、栈队列、排序和树遍历，再练链表重连、堆、回溯、贪心、动态规划和图。外存统计、流式解析、无偏随机和检索排序放在最后做综合题。一次做对不等于熟练：隔一段时间重新推导，比只记上次的代码更有用。

主体 Java 代码使用 Java 17 语法；完整配套运行环境为 Java 21，其中并发测试辅助类 Checks 使用 Java 21 的线程构建 API，各个 public 类按类名存为同名文件。公共的树与链表方法集中在本章的完整类里；其余示例通常自带 main。测试类也完整列在书内，可以连同被测类直接编译运行。因此全包应在 Java 21 上编译运行，不把目标字节码 17 误作全包支持 Java 17 运行时的声明。编译命令示例：

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
java -m jdk.compiler/com.sun.tools.javac.Main -source 17 -target 17 -d classes code/*.java
java -cp classes CoreAlgorithmsTest
java -cp classes TreeListTest

这个命令指定源码级别与目标字节码级别，并不等同于在 Java 17 运行时执行，也不限制只能引用 Java 17 平台 API。跨版本部署时，还应使用目标 JDK 或正确的平台约束再检查一遍。代码的算法复杂度不包括输入输出和测试 oracle，除非题目专门讨论它们；BigInteger 的运算位数、输出集合大小、递归栈和磁盘 I/O 会另行说明。

原生语言本身是考点的题，保留 C++、Python、Go 或 JavaScript 实现与 Java 对照。Python 的本地 10T 日志题保留完整磁盘方案；它不需要借助 Python 并发知识才能理解。

开始写代码之前，先问哪几件事

先确认“数据长什么样、答案是什么、哪些资源能用”，这样才能判断算法是否适用。

  • 数组是否有序，是否允许负数、重复值和修改原数组？区间是闭区间还是半开区间？
  • 字符按字节、UTF-16 code unit、Unicode 码点，还是用户看到的字素簇计数？本书每个文本接口都会说明选择。
  • “第 K 大”是否保留重复值？“频率最高”统计记录次数还是不同用户人数？“重复行”是每种重复内容一次、所有重复记录，还是去重后的全集？
  • 节点相等按值还是按对象身份？链表是否无环且互不共享节点？树是否真的是树？
  • 返回长度、一个答案、全部答案，还是还要恢复路径？并列答案用什么规则？无解用空结果、-1 还是异常？
  • 内存上限是否包括哈希表对象开销、输入缓冲和输出？是否允许临时磁盘、多次扫描、多机和近似误差？

复杂度中的 O(1) 也有条件。固定 32 位整数的 32 层基数划分可以视为常数层；任意长度整数不能这样算。哈希查询一般说期望或平均 O(1)，动态数组扩容一般说均摊 O(1)。Java 的 ArrayDeque 禁止 null，且常用两端操作是均摊常数时间；它不是线程安全容器。

面试中可以坦诚说明不熟悉某个方案，再提出已经能证明和实现的备选方案；不要承诺面试官一定接受换题。准备时间按自己的基础和薄弱点安排，不把某个“突击天数”或刷题遍数当作通过保证。

一、题设条件、数据结构与排序

相关练习：堆、排序与 Top K。

二、数组、二分、双指针与区间

相关练习：数组与矩阵。

三、字符串、窗口、前缀与单调结构

相关练习：滑动窗口。

四、链表、栈、队列与缓存

相关练习：链表。

六、图、网格与依赖

相关练习：图与搜索。

七、回溯与贪心

相关练习：回溯。

八、动态规划与状态设计

相关练习：动态规划。

九、堆、随机与数值计算

相关练习：数学、随机与几何。

十、外存、日志与流式处理

相关练习：排序与 Top K 基础。

十一、解析、对象路径与前端算法

相关练习：递归下降与结构化解析。

十二、检索、排序融合与结构化知识库

相关练习：哈希与计数基础。

十三、完整自测程序

手撕题先检查接口，再检查算法：用明确样例确认输入输出口径，用小输入的暴力枚举结果对照优化实现。固定随机种子，失败时才能重放同一个反例。

测试 oracle 可以比被测算法更慢、更占空间，因为它在小输入上负责给出可信对照。随机测试能帮你找错，但没有找到反例，并不等于已经证明算法正确。

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;

/** 固定随机种子；小输入暴力 oracle 与实现相互独立。直接运行 main。 */
public final class CoreAlgorithmsTest {
    static long checks;
    static final Random RANDOM = new Random(20261011L);
    static void check(boolean value) { checks++; if (!value) throw new AssertionError("check " + checks); }
    static void eq(Object actual, Object expected) { checks++; if (!Objects.deepEquals(actual, expected)) throw new AssertionError("check " + checks + ": " + actual + " != " + expected); }
    static void invalid(Runnable call) { checks++; try { call.run(); throw new AssertionError("exception expected"); } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { } }
    static int[] randomArray(int length, int bound, int offset) { int[] a = new int[length]; for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) a[i] = RANDOM.nextInt(bound) + offset; return a; }
    static Set<List<Integer>> tuples(int[] a, int k, long target) { Set<List<Integer>> result = new HashSet<>(); tuples(a, k, target, 0, new ArrayList<>(), result); return result; }
    static void tuples(int[] a, int k, long target, int at, List<Integer> path, Set<List<Integer>> result) {
        if (k == 0) { if (target == 0) { List<Integer> values = new ArrayList<>(path); Collections.sort(values); result.add(values); } return; }
        for (int i = at; i < a.length; i++) { path.add(a[i]); tuples(a, k - 1, target - a[i], i + 1, path, result); path.remove(path.size() - 1); }
    }
    static long histogram(int[] a) { long best = 0; for (int l = 0; l < a.length; l++) { int low = Integer.MAX_VALUE; for (int r = l; r < a.length; r++) { low = Math.min(low, a[r]); best = Math.max(best, (long) low * (r - l + 1)); } } return best; }
    static int[] temperatures(int[] a) { int[] result = new int[a.length]; for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) for (int j = i + 1; j < a.length; j++) if (a[j] > a[i]) { result[i] = j - i; break; } return result; }
    static int[] circularGreater(int[] a) { int[] result = new int[a.length]; Arrays.fill(result, -1); for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) for (int step = 1; step < a.length; step++) if (a[(i + step) % a.length] > a[i]) { result[i] = a[(i + step) % a.length]; break; } return result; }
    static void arrays() {
        eq(ArrayStringBasics.sortedSquares(new int[]{Integer.MIN_VALUE, -2, 0, 3, Integer.MAX_VALUE}), new long[]{0, 4, 9, 4611686014132420609L, 4611686018427387904L});
        check(ArrayStringBasics.isAnagram("😀a😀", "a😀😀")); check(!ArrayStringBasics.isAnagram("aab", "abb")); eq(ArrayStringBasics.intersection(new int[]{1, 2, 2}, new int[]{2, 3, 1, 2}), new int[]{2, 1});
        check(ArrayStringBasics.isHappy(19)); check(!ArrayStringBasics.isHappy(2)); check(!ArrayStringBasics.isHappy(0));
        check(ArrayStringBasics.canConstruct("😀😀", "a😀😀")); check(!ArrayStringBasics.canConstruct("aa", "a"));
        eq(ArrayStringBasics.fourSumCount(new int[]{1,2}, new int[]{-2,-1}, new int[]{-1,2}, new int[]{0,2}), 2L);
        char[] chars = "abcdef".toCharArray(); ArrayStringBasics.reverse(chars); eq(new String(chars), "fedcba");
        eq(ArrayStringBasics.reverseEvery2K("abcdefg", 2), "bacdfeg"); eq(ArrayStringBasics.replaceDigits("a1b０2"), "anumberb０number"); eq(ArrayStringBasics.rotateRight("abcdefg", 2), "fgabcde");
        check(ArrayStringBasics.repeatedSubstring("abab")); check(!ArrayStringBasics.repeatedSubstring("aba")); check(!ArrayStringBasics.repeatedSubstring(""));
        check(ArrayStringBasics.validBrackets("([]{})")); check(!ArrayStringBasics.validBrackets("([)]")); check(!ArrayStringBasics.validBrackets("a")); eq(ArrayStringBasics.removeAdjacentDuplicates("abbaca"), "ca");
        eq(ArrayStringBasics.evaluateRpn(List.of("2","1","+","3","*")), 9L); invalid(() -> ArrayStringBasics.evaluateRpn(List.of("1","2"))); invalid(() -> ArrayStringBasics.reverseEvery2K("a", 0)); invalid(() -> ArrayStringBasics.largestHistogram(new int[]{-1}));
        eq(ArrayStringBasics.fourSum(new int[]{Integer.MAX_VALUE,Integer.MAX_VALUE,Integer.MIN_VALUE,Integer.MIN_VALUE}, -2), List.of(List.of(Integer.MIN_VALUE,Integer.MIN_VALUE,Integer.MAX_VALUE,Integer.MAX_VALUE)));
        check(ArrayStringBasics.fourSum(new int[]{1,2,3,4}, Long.MIN_VALUE).isEmpty());
        for (int t = 0; t < 2500; t++) {
            int[] a = randomArray(RANDOM.nextInt(10), 9, -4), before = a.clone(); long target = RANDOM.nextInt(15) - 7;
            eq(new HashSet<>(ArrayStringBasics.threeSum(a)), tuples(a, 3, 0)); eq(new HashSet<>(ArrayStringBasics.fourSum(a, target)), tuples(a, 4, target)); eq(a, before);
            eq(ArrayStringBasics.dailyTemperatures(a), temperatures(a)); eq(ArrayStringBasics.nextGreaterCircular(a), circularGreater(a));
            int value = RANDOM.nextInt(9) - 4; int[] copy = a.clone(), expected = Arrays.stream(a).filter(x -> x != value).toArray(); int length = ArrayStringBasics.removeElement(copy, value); eq(Arrays.copyOf(copy, length), expected);
            int[] heights = randomArray(a.length, 8, 0); eq(ArrayStringBasics.largestHistogram(heights), histogram(heights));
            int[] sorted = a.clone(); Arrays.sort(sorted); int lower = 0, upper = 0; while (lower < sorted.length && sorted[lower] < value) lower++; while (upper < sorted.length && sorted[upper] <= value) upper++;
            eq(A1BinaryBounds.lowerBound(sorted, value), lower); eq(A1BinaryBounds.upperBound(sorted, value), upper);
            long count = 0; for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { long sum = 0; for (int j = i; j < a.length; j++) { sum += a[j]; if (sum == target) count++; } } eq(A4PrefixSumCount.countSubarraysWithSum(a, target), count);
            if (a.length > 0) { int k = 1 + RANDOM.nextInt(a.length); int[] maximum = new int[a.length - k + 1]; for (int i = 0; i < maximum.length; i++) { maximum[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE; for (int j = i; j < i + k; j++) maximum[i] = Math.max(maximum[i], a[j]); } eq(A5WindowMaximum.slidingWindowMaximum(a, k), maximum); }
            StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder(), pattern = new StringBuilder(); for (int x : a) text.append((char) ('a' + Math.floorMod(x, 3))); for (int i = 0; i < RANDOM.nextInt(6); i++) pattern.append((char) ('a' + RANDOM.nextInt(3))); eq(ArrayStringBasics.firstMatch(text.toString(), pattern.toString()), text.indexOf(pattern.toString()));
        }
    }
    static int lis(int[] a) { int best = 0; for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << a.length); mask++) { int previous = 0, count = 0; boolean first = true, valid = true; for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) { if (!first && a[i] <= previous) valid = false; first = false; previous = a[i]; count++; } if (valid) best = Math.max(best, count); } return best; }
    static long rob(int[] a, boolean circle) { long best = 0; for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << a.length); mask++) { if ((mask & (mask << 1)) != 0 || circle && a.length > 1 && (mask & 1) != 0 && (mask & (1 << (a.length - 1))) != 0) continue; long sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) sum += a[i]; best = Math.max(best, sum); } return best; }
    static long stock(int[] a, int day, boolean holding, int remaining, boolean cooldown, boolean blocked) {
        if (day == a.length) return holding ? Long.MIN_VALUE / 4 : 0;
        long result = stock(a, day + 1, holding, remaining, cooldown, false);
        if (holding && remaining > 0) result = Math.max(result, a[day] + stock(a, day + 1, false, remaining - 1, cooldown, cooldown));
        if (!holding && !blocked && remaining > 0) result = Math.max(result, -a[day] + stock(a, day + 1, true, remaining, cooldown, false)); return result;
    }
    static int lcs(String a, String b, int i, int j) { if (i == a.length() || j == b.length()) return 0; return a.charAt(i) == b.charAt(j) ? 1 + lcs(a,b,i+1,j+1) : Math.max(lcs(a,b,i+1,j), lcs(a,b,i,j+1)); }
    static boolean palindrome(String s) { for (int i = 0; i < s.length()/2; i++) if (s.charAt(i) != s.charAt(s.length()-1-i)) return false; return true; }
    static void dynamic() {
        eq(DynamicPatterns.fibonacci(100).toString(), "354224848179261915075"); eq(DynamicPatterns.uniquePaths(3,7), BigInteger.valueOf(28)); eq(DynamicPatterns.pathsWithObstacles(new int[][]{{0,0,0},{0,1,0},{0,0,0}}), BigInteger.TWO);
        eq(DynamicPatterns.integerBreak(10), BigInteger.valueOf(36)); eq(DynamicPatterns.countBsts(3), BigInteger.valueOf(5)); eq(DynamicPatterns.countBsts(0), BigInteger.ONE);
        eq(DynamicPatterns.maximumBinaryStrings(new String[]{"10","0001","111001","1","0"},5,3),4); eq(DynamicPatterns.maximumBinaryStrings(new String[]{"","","0"},0,0),2);
        eq(DynamicPatterns.coinCombinations(new int[]{1,2,5,2},5),BigInteger.valueOf(4)); eq(DynamicPatterns.orderedCompositions(new int[]{1,2,3},4),BigInteger.valueOf(7));
        check(DynamicPatterns.wordBreak("leetcode", List.of("leet","code"))); check(!DynamicPatterns.wordBreak("catsandog", List.of("cats","dog","sand","and","cat"))); check(DynamicPatterns.wordBreak("",List.of("a")));
        eq(DynamicPatterns.deletionsToEqual("sea","eat"),2L); eq(DynamicPatterns.uncrossedLines(new int[]{1,4,2},new int[]{1,2,4}),2); check(DynamicPatterns.isSubsequence("ace","abcde")); check(!DynamicPatterns.isSubsequence("aec","abcde"));
        invalid(() -> DynamicPatterns.coinCombinations(new int[]{0},3)); invalid(() -> DynamicPatterns.equalPartition(new int[]{-1})); invalid(() -> DynamicPatterns.wordBreak("x", List.of(""))); invalid(() -> DynamicPatterns.stockAtMostK(new int[]{1},-1));
        for (int t = 0; t < 1800; t++) {
            int[] a = randomArray(RANDOM.nextInt(9),7,0); long total = Arrays.stream(a).asLongStream().sum(), difference = Long.MAX_VALUE; int target = RANDOM.nextInt(21)-10, ways = 0; boolean equal = false;
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << a.length); mask++) { long sum = 0; for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) sum += a[i]; long value = 2 * sum - total; if (value == 0) equal = true; if (value == target) ways++; difference = Math.min(difference, Math.abs(value)); }
            eq(DynamicPatterns.equalPartition(a),equal); eq(DynamicPatterns.lastStoneMinimum(a),difference); eq(DynamicPatterns.targetSumWays(a,target),BigInteger.valueOf(ways)); eq(DynamicPatterns.robLine(a),rob(a,false)); eq(DynamicPatterns.robCircle(a),rob(a,true));
            int k = RANDOM.nextInt(4); eq(DynamicPatterns.stockAtMostK(a,k),stock(a,0,false,k,false,false)); eq(DynamicPatterns.stockWithCooldown(a),stock(a,0,false,a.length,true,false));
            int[] sequence = A8IncreasingSubsequence.longestIncreasingSubsequence(a); eq(sequence.length,lis(a)); int match = 0; for (int value : a) if (match < sequence.length && value == sequence[match]) match++; eq(match,sequence.length); for (int i=1;i<sequence.length;i++) check(sequence[i]>sequence[i-1]);
            int continuous=0; for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){int end=i+1;while(end<a.length&&a[end]>a[end-1])end++;continuous=Math.max(continuous,end-i);} eq(DynamicPatterns.continuousIncreasing(a),continuous);
            int[] b=randomArray(RANDOM.nextInt(8),7,0);int repeated=0;for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)for(int j=0;j<b.length;j++){int length=0;while(i+length<a.length&&j+length<b.length&&a[i+length]==b[j+length])length++;repeated=Math.max(repeated,length);}eq(DynamicPatterns.repeatedSubarray(a,b),repeated);
            StringBuilder text=new StringBuilder(), other=new StringBuilder();for(int value:a)text.append((char)('a'+value%3));for(int value:b)other.append((char)('a'+value%3));String s=text.toString(); long palCount=0;int palSequence=0;for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++)for(int j=i+1;j<=s.length();j++)if(palindrome(s.substring(i,j)))palCount++;for(int mask=0;mask<(1<<s.length());mask++){StringBuilder sub=new StringBuilder();for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++)if((mask&(1<<i))!=0)sub.append(s.charAt(i));if(palindrome(sub.toString()))palSequence=Math.max(palSequence,sub.length());}
            eq(DynamicPatterns.countPalindromes(s),palCount);eq(DynamicPatterns.longestPalindromicSubsequence(s),palSequence);eq(DynamicPatterns.lcsLength(s,other.toString()),lcs(s,other.toString(),0,0));
            long[] costs=new long[a.length+2];for(int i=a.length-1;i>=0;i--)costs[i]=a[i]+Math.min(costs[i+1],costs[i+2]);eq(DynamicPatterns.minimumClimbingCost(a),Math.min(costs[0],costs[1]));
        }

一次运行配套测试

配套脚本按语言编译并执行所有自测，标准输入输出样例还会逐字比较；遇到缺失工具或失败会报告具体项目，而不会下载软件或静默跳过。

解压代码包后在其根目录执行 python3 run_tests.py --build-dir build --jobs 2。需要 Java 21、Python 3.12、Node.js、支持 C11 的 gcc 和支持 C++17 的 g++；C/C++ 检查还启用未定义行为检测器。脚本生成的 build 目录保存编译产物、每项结果和输入文件摘要。使用不同工具链时，应先核对相应语言与标准库接口。

--stress 额外生成约 40 MB 的数值输入，并在 24 MiB Java 堆下做外排序资源回归；文件描述符上限如需控制，应由操作系统环境另行设置。这个用例不等于对 1 TB 输入作性能承诺。Go 默认不执行；已准备兼容 Go 工具链时可以显式加 --go，运行容器示例和带竞争检测的并发测试。

完整运行脚本如下，独立文件名为 run_tests.py：

run_tests.py · 配套代码包测试入口
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile and run the book's reproducible tests. Requires Java21, Python3.12, Node and C/C++ compilers.
Go is opt-in (--go); --stress runs a 40MB external-sort resource regression.
No downloads, network access, package installs or external services are used.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--build-dir', type=Path, default=ROOT / 'build')
    parser.add_argument('--jobs', type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument('--go', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--stress', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.jobs < 1:
        parser.error('--jobs must be positive')
    build = args.build_dir.resolve(); build.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    classes = build / 'classes'; classes.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    results = []
    def run(name, command, stdin='', expected=None, timeout=240):
        begin = time.monotonic()
        try:
            proc = subprocess.run(command, input=stdin, text=True, capture_output=True, cwd=ROOT,
                                  timeout=timeout, env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'})
            ok = proc.returncode == 0 and (expected is None or proc.stdout.replace('\r\n','\n') == expected)
            row = dict(name=name, command=list(map(str, command)), returncode=proc.returncode,
                       stdout=proc.stdout, stderr=proc.stderr, ok=ok)
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
            row = dict(name=name, command=list(map(str, command)), ok=False, error=str(error))
        row['seconds'] = round(time.monotonic()-begin, 3)
        return row
    sources = sorted((ROOT / 'code').glob('*.java'))
    compiled = run('compile-java', ['java', '-m', 'jdk.compiler/com.sun.tools.javac.Main', '-source', '17',
                    '-target', '17', '-encoding', 'UTF-8', '-d', str(classes), *map(str,sources)])
    results.append(compiled)
    print('compile-java', compiled['ok'], flush=True)
    if not compiled['ok']:
        print(compiled, file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
    tasks = []
    skipped_cli = {'AcmExercises','EMBoundedStress','EMTool','LruCli','TreeVariants','RightViewACM',
                   'RebuildTraversals','ReverseKGroupAcm','ArrayTreeLca'}
    for source in sources:
        if not re.search(r'public\s+static\s+void\s+main\s*\(', source.read_text()) or source.stem in skipped_cli:
            continue
        options = ['--self-test'] if source.stem in {'TreeTraversalACM','LongestPalindromeACM'} else []
        tasks.append((source.stem, ['java','-Xmx256m','-cp',str(classes),source.stem,*options]))
    tasks += [
        ('rebuild-traversals-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'RebuildTraversals'],'5\n3 9 20 15 7\n9 3 15 20 7\n','3 9 20 15 7\n9 3 15 20 7\n'),
        ('rebuild-traversals-empty-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'RebuildTraversals'],'0\n','\n\n'),
        ('reverse-kgroup-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'ReverseKGroupAcm'],'5 2\n1 2 3 4 5\n','2 1 4 3 5\n'),
        ('reverse-kgroup-empty-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'ReverseKGroupAcm'],'0 1\n','\n'),
        ('array-lca-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'ArrayTreeLca'],'5 3\n7 -1 -1\n7 0 2\n7 -1 -1\n9 1 4\n9 -1 -1\n0 2\n','1 7\n'),
        ('array-lca-empty-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'ArrayTreeLca'],'0 -1\n-1 -1\n','NOT_FOUND\n'),
        ('right-view-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'RightViewACM'],'[1,2,3,null,5,null,4]\n','[1, 3, 4]\n'),
        ('traversals-empty-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'TreeTraversalACM'],'0\n','\n\n\n'),
        ('palindrome-empty-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'LongestPalindromeACM'],'',''),
        ('lru-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'LruCli'],'2\nPUT a 1\nPUT b 2\nGET a\nPUT c 3\nGET b\nEVICT 9\n','1\nNULL\n2\n'),
        ('tree-codec-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'TreeVariants'],'#\n1 2 # # 3 # #\n-2147483648 # #\n','#\n1 2 # # 3 # #\n-2147483648 # #\n'),
        ('products-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'AcmExercises','products'],'6\n1.50 2 1\n0.10 0 4\n1.5 1 1\n0.9 1 0\n2 1 1\n1.2 -1 1\n0\n','4\n6 1.2\n1 1.5\n3 1.5\n5 2\n0\n'),
        ('candy-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'AcmExercises','candy'],'3 1 0 2\n3 1 2 2\n','5\n4\n'),
        ('max-subarray-cli',['java','-cp',str(classes),'AcmExercises','max-subarray'],'3 -2 -1 -3\n4 1 -2 3 4\n','-1\n7\n'),
    ]
    for name in ['python_sequence_contracts.py','three_sum_test.py','reorder_list.py','log_decorator_test.py',
                 'test_ssa_incremental_decimal.py','line_index_test.py']:
        tasks.append((name,[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'native'/name)]))
    tasks.append(('video-uv',[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'native/video_uv_external.py'),'--self-test']))
    for name in ['native_test.mjs','promise_order_test.mjs','native_js.mjs']:
        tasks.append((name,['node',str(ROOT/'native'/name)]))
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.jobs) as workers:
        futures = {workers.submit(run,*task):task[0] for task in tasks}
        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            row=future.result(); results.append(row)
            print(row['name'], 'PASS' if row['ok'] else 'FAIL', row['seconds'], flush=True)
            (build/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    for source in sorted((ROOT/'native').glob('*.cpp')) + sorted((ROOT/'native').glob('*.c')):
        cpp=source.suffix=='.cpp'; executable=build/source.stem
        command=['g++' if cpp else 'gcc','-std=c++17' if cpp else '-std=c11','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic',
                 '-fsanitize=undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=undefined','-pthread','-O1',str(source),'-o',str(executable)]
        row=run('compile-'+source.name,command);results.append(row)
        if row['ok']:results.append(run(source.name,[str(executable)]))
        print(source.name,'PASS' if results[-1]['ok'] else 'FAIL',flush=True)
    if args.stress:
        results.append(run('external-40MB-heap24MiB',['java','-Xmx24m','-cp',str(classes),'EMBoundedStress'],timeout=900))
    if args.go:
        # Run only when explicitly requested and a Go toolchain is already available.
        if not shutil.which('go'):
            raise SystemExit('Go requested but not installed; no automatic installation')
        go_dir=ROOT/'native/go_concurrency'
        results.append(run('go-concurrency',['go','-C',str(go_dir),'test','-race','./...'],timeout=600))
        results.append(run('go-containers',['go','run',str(ROOT/'native/go_containers.go')],timeout=600))
    pins={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for folder in ['code','native'] for p in (ROOT/folder).rglob('*')
          if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}
    (build/'input-sha256.json').write_text(json.dumps(pins,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    (build/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    failures=[row['name'] for row in results if not row['ok']]
    print('Final:',len(results),'steps;',len(failures),'failures;', 'Go run' if args.go else 'Go not run')
    if failures:
        print('Failures:',', '.join(failures));raise SystemExit(1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
